title: Filtered homotopies agree on spectral sequences from the second page
statement: Let $C^\bullet$ and $D^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in an abelian category, each equipped with a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] by subcomplexes (so $d(F^pC^n)\subseteq F^pC^{n+1}$, and likewise for $D^\bullet$) such that for every cochain degree $n$ there are integers $p_-$ and $p_+$ with $F^{p_-}C^n=C^n$, $F^{p_+}C^n=0$, and likewise for $D^n$. Let $a,b:C^\bullet\to D^\bullet$ be filtered chain maps, and suppose there are maps $h^n:C^n\to D^{n-1}$ with $a-b=d_Dh+hd_C$ and $h^n(F^pC^n)\subseteq F^{p-1}D^{n-1}$ for every $p$. Then the spectral-sequence maps induced by $a$ and $b$ are equal on every page $E_r$ for $r\ge2$, and their maps on the abutment filtrations and the associated graded pieces [def-sp-convergence] agree.

proof.text: The boundedness hypotheses make the filtrations on both complexes bounded in each cochain degree, so [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields](a) constructs their spectral sequences, while (b) identifies the abutment filtrations and (c) makes every filtered chain map induce a compatible map on every page. The maps a and b therefore induce spectral-sequence morphisms.

source.place: Lemma 012O and the bounded filtered-complex construction preceding it

proof.text: Fix $r\ge2$ and use the $Z_r/B_r$ description in [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields](a), choosing $N\ge r$ so large that $F^{p+N}C^{p+q+1}=0$ and $F^{p+N}D^{p+q}=0$ (possible by the degreewise boundedness). Then a class of $Z_r^{p,q}(C)$ is the image of the class of a cocycle $x\in F^pC^{p+q}$, $d_Cx=0$, and $(a-b)x=d_D(hx)$ with $hx\in F^{p-1}D^{p+q-1}\subseteq F^{p-r+1}D^{p+q-1}$. So the class of $(a-b)x$ in $H^{p+q}(F^pD/F^{p+r}D)$ is the coboundary of the class of $hx$ in $F^{p-r+1}D/F^{p}D$, i.e. it lies in $B_r^{p,q}(D)$ and vanishes in $E_r^{p,q}(D)$. Hence $a$ and $b$ induce the same map on $E_r$ for every $r\ge2$.

source.place: Lemma 012O, functoriality, with the filtered-complex homotopy calculation (standard one-step filtration-shift argument)

proof.text: The induced maps on cohomology of the total complexes are equal because a-b=d_Dh+hd_C is a chain homotopy. By [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields](b), the abutment filtrations are the image filtrations from the filtered complexes and the E_infty identifications with their graded pieces are natural for filtered maps. Hence the common cohomology map preserves the two image filtrations and induces the same maps on every associated graded piece; these are precisely the abutment filtration and graded-piece maps in the statement.

lean.statement: theorem filteredHomotopy_spectralSequence_map_eq (K L : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (G : DecreasingFiltration L) (hKF : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ, F.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ F.complexStep pmax n = ⊥) (hLG : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ, G.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ G.complexStep pmax n = ⊥) (a b : FilteredObject.Hom ⟨K, F⟩ ⟨L, G⟩) (H : Homotopy a.hom b.hom) (hshift : ∀ (p n : ℤ), ∃ ℓ : (F.complexStep p n : C) ⟶ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1) : C), ℓ ≫ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1)).arrow = (F.complexStep p n).arrow ≫ H.hom n (n - 1)) : (∀ (M : FilteredPageTwoModel C), M.S.map a = M.S.map b) ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (AF : DecreasingFiltration (K.homology n)) (BF : DecreasingFiltration (L.homology n)), (∀ p : ℤ, AF.step p = imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.step p).arrow n)) → (∀ p : ℤ, BF.step p = imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.step p).arrow n)) → ∃ t : FilteredObject.Hom ⟨K.homology n, AF⟩ ⟨L.homology n, BF⟩, t.hom = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap a.hom n ∧ t.hom = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap b.hom n ∧ ∀ p : ℤ, ∃ g : AF.gradedPiece p ⟶ BF.gradedPiece p, cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (AF.step (p + 1)) (AF.step p) (AF.antitone_step (by omega))) ≫ g = Classical.choose (t.preserves p) ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (BF.step (p + 1)) (BF.step p) (BF.antitone_step (by omega))))
